soundness_flags.label: Theorem 2 (thm:exact-milp)
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed bijection is false as written: each connected block admits multiple feasible choices of its root variables r_vk (and the quotient by label permutations cannot be bijective with the labeled class C_K(G)); state projection/surjectivity and objective preservation instead.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The cited ICML proceedings paper exists and presents a surrogate MSE objective for spatial experimental design.
The paper gives a generic bounded-treewidth dynamic program for connected partitions into prescribed-size parts.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv preprint corresponding to the 2015 Information and Computation article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The work develops deterministic rank-based representative-set reductions for weighted connectivity dynamic programs on tree decompositions.
The paper optimizes worst-case cluster-design MSE through a penalized min-cut computed with semidefinite methods.
The two-wave network-design paper studies pilot-estimated variance and oracle-regret guarantees for its own design problem.
The paper optimizes worst-case GATE MSE over assignment covariance matrices using SDP, Gaussian rounding, and a Gram-Schmidt-walk approach.
The paper derives interference-dependent convergence rates, asymptotic normality, and a variance estimator for spatial cluster-randomized designs.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Repair Theorem 2 by replacing the false bijection with an objective-preserving projection from feasible MILP points to labeled connected partitions, and explicitly characterize root-variable multiplicity.
Promote the four-cycle separation into a generic nondegenerate family of covariance-supported graphs and characterize a sufficient or necessary surrogate-versus-V order-equivalence condition.
State the treewidth parameter explicitly as tw(F)+K and benchmark the exact DP against the MILP on sparse covariance-support instances, including certificate size and verification time.

recommended_next_step: Revise the MILP exactness theorem to remove the false bijection claim, then advance the field-tier exact-optimization kernel to Stage 0.
